original.title: Component-local signed overlap identity
original.statement: For the partial injection between two retained rows, a path's change in overlap with past diagonal labels is the indicator of ownership of its exit minus that of its root; a cycle contributes zero. Under a diagonal drop, every exit is owned and the global overlap gain equals the count of unowned roots lost from the row.
assumptions: Injective old and new rows on the same domain; canonical diagonal maximality and old-diagonal MEX cover for drop consequence. UnitDip remains open.

exactAuditedStatement: For old/new injective rows a, b on the same finite column set U, edges c->d when b_c=a_d form paths/cycles. For path root old label x and exit new label z, overlap with fixed O changes by1_O(z)-1_O(x); cycles contribute0. If every new label is below old D and every positive label below D lies in O union A, then all path exits owned and |B intersect O|-|A intersect O|=|(A minus B)minus O|.
hypotheses: Identical retained domain U={0,..., q-2}, q>=2.
Drop corollary uses positivity, strict new diagonal maximum<old D and old diagonal MEX cover.
proofDependencyMap: Row injectivity only for generic component theorem.
Canonical maximality/positive-MEX cover for drop instance; root foundation needed only for instantiation.
independentDerivationAndChecks: Injectivity bounds in/outdegrees by1. A root with indegree0 cannot enter a cycle: the first cycle entry would have an external predecessor besides its cycle predecessor. Distinct root paths cannot merge by the same indegree bound. Finite components are paths or cycles.

On path c0->...->ck, b_ci=a_c(i+1) for i<k. Internal old/new labels cancel as sets; exactly x=a_c0 is lost and z=b_ck gained. Cycle label sets coincide. This does not require monotonic labels along edges.

Every exit belongs B minus A globally: otherwise it would have an outgoing edge. Under drop z<D and positive, old MEX coverage forces z in O. Root labels are exactly A minus B; thus owned roots contribute0 and unowned roots1. Sum components for global formula.

The old penultimate p belongs A but is notin the project strict old source; actual LowLoss excludes p and D-1and requires absence/nonpast guards. The identity cannot replace all those guards or bound eligible paths by1.
